meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: Claude 会把代码库梳理成按功能分组的 Mermaid 流程图，列出跨功能的重复实现，提出一份统一架构方案，并为每个统一后的系统生成可直接交给 /make-plan 的提示词。它自己不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你要求「find the ideal path」、统一重复系统，或想在重构前审查架构时触发。它会先做功能边界发现，再逐项展开。

say.text: 帮我找出这个项目里的理想路径，先梳理出功能边界和流程图
看看哪些功能之间有重复的实现，给我一份带出处的重复清单
给统一后的每个系统各写一份 /make-plan 提示词

howto.what_en: Claude maps your codebase into Mermaid flowcharts grouped by feature, reports duplicated concerns across features, proposes a unified architecture, and writes per-system /make-plan prompts. It writes no implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. It starts with feature-boundary discovery.

say_en.text: Find the ideal path in this project — start with feature boundaries and flowcharts
Show me which features duplicate each other, with a cited duplication list
Write a /make-plan prompt for each unified system
